notes: Manufacturer's own page (legrandav.com/Da-Lite) returned SSL certificate errors on every fetch attempt during research, so the B&H Photo "Specs" tab (a reputable AV retailer spec table) was used instead — it lists the same TCP/IP, VPI Trigger, RS-232, and PoE+ control features confirmed via the overview text and product photo. Also controllable via TCP/IP and RS-232 per the product description, but no dedicated physical RS-232 (DB9) or Ethernet-data-only jack is broken out in the spec table — control appears to route through the same PoE RJ45 (web UI / TCP/IP) and possibly VPI/dry-contact terminals not itemized as a distinct connector in the retailer spec sheet, so those control paths are not represented as separate ports here. No Ethernet speed/grade (e.g. 100M/1G) is stated anywhere, so grade was omitted on the RJ45 ports per instructions. Direction on the Screen, Wall Switch, and IR jacks is inferred from typical function (not explicitly labeled input/output by the manufacturer); per task rule all RJ45 ports are marked bidirectional regardless of typical data flow. The IR jack's exact connector wiring (mono TS vs TRS) isn't confirmed; used the dedicated "ir" connector id as the closest/best match. Device is a small desktop/wall-mount box (0.865 lb, ~8.7x7.4x4.2" shipping box) — not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted.

ports.name: PoE
ports.note: Network connection; also the PoE+ power input for the unit (5–12VDC, 30W draw; ships with a PoE+ injector and AC cord)

ports.name: Screen
ports.note: Proprietary low-voltage control link to a Da-Lite motorized screen's control board

ports.name: Wall Switch 1
ports.note: Low-voltage wired wall switch input for local up/down/stop control

ports.name: Wall Switch 2
ports.note: Second low-voltage wired wall switch input

ports.name: IR
ports.note: 3.5mm jack for a wired IR receiver eye
